description: Union trades laborers sequence for hazmat awareness and abatement support: read the job hazard analysis, suit up with a seal check, build containment with negative air and a decon corridor, work wet methods only, then bag, label, decon out and complete the waste manifest. Aligned to the hazmat/abatement core of laborers' training catalogues (Laborers' Training Center of Northern California — alignment from the 2026-11-10 industry pass, not a partnership). Simulation only — not HAZWOPER certification, not an asbestos or lead worker/supervisor licence, not an apprenticeship credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4). The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.

objectives: Read a job hazard analysis and name the stop-work triggers
Don a respirator and suit and pass a seal and buddy check
Build containment with negative air and a three-stage decon corridor
Work wet methods only — no dry sweeping, no visible dust
Bag, label and manifest regulated waste, and decon out in order

sites.indiana: Proposed/planned training site — no site, city, or address named.
sites.louisiana: Proposed/planned training site — no site, city, or address named.

sources: OSHA asbestos topic page and standards (osha.gov/asbestos): regulated areas, exposure controls, wet methods, housekeeping and waste rules for asbestos work.
OSHA lead in construction topic page (osha.gov/lead): exposure assessment and hygiene/decontamination practice.
OSHA PPE topic page (osha.gov/personal-protective-equipment): respirator fit, seal checks, limitations.
Industry pass 1 (2026-11-10): Laborers' Training Center of Northern California catalogue is hazmat/abatement training — alignment reference only.

stations.title: Briefing board — job hazard analysis, exposure controls posted
Containment — sealed work area, negative-air machine, decon corridor
Waste & decon desk — labelled bags, decon line, manifest forms

steps.action: Briefing: read the job hazard analysis. Name the material (asbestos or lead), the exposure controls for this job, and the stop-work triggers.
steps.check: Hazards, controls and stop-work triggers named.

steps.action: PPE: don the respirator and suit; run the fit/seal check and a buddy check before crossing into the work area.
Build containment: seal the work area, start the negative-air machine, and lay out the three-stage decon corridor in order.
steps.check: Containment sealed; negative air running; corridor in order.

steps.action: Work the job wet: keep material wet, hand tools over power tools inside containment, no dry sweeping at any point.
steps.check: Wet methods used throughout; no visible dust.

steps.action: Bag and label the waste, decon out through the corridor in order, and complete the waste manifest at the desk.
steps.check: Waste bagged and labelled; manifest complete; decon done in order.
